incidents.title: Customs call that cites the public cybercrime helpline

evidence.excerpt:
Caller: This is Mumbai Customs. Pay the clearance fee to clearance55@oksbi.
Victim: Is this real?
Caller: Yes, you can verify it on helpline 1930....
Dear Customer, your monthly bank statement has been dispatched to your registered email address. For inquiries, visit your nearest bank branch with or...

counter_evidence.observation: The shared identifier is used in a benign context: 1930 is a public identifier (National Cyber Crime Helpline).

evidence_refs.excerpt:

counter_evidence.explanation: Genuine notices and scam calls can both cite an official identifier, so seeing it twice says nothing about a common origin. The match is disputed until an analyst decides.

counter_evidence.observation: The incidents claim different institutions (Bank vs Courier Customs).
counter_evidence.explanation: One group can impersonate several institutions, but a different claimed institution makes a common origin less likely.

explanation: Exact normalized PHONE '1930' observed in evidence of both incidents.
